verdict.rationale: The evidence shows sensor simulation, custom plugins, a plugin interface to physics engines, and pub/sub transport. None of it documents a stable hardware-abstraction layer that lets engineers swap sensors or actuators without changing application code. Plugins and gz-transport messaging are developer building blocks, and the physics-engine plugin interface is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can swap sensors and actuators behind stable hardware-abstraction interfaces without rewriting application code
